lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the branchial region, high-luminance blobs are arranged in a regular grid pattern. Vertical columns of 4-5 spots are aligned with horizontal rows that maintain consistent spacing along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (lighter pixels on the superior edge, darker shadow pixels on the inferior edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within its silhouette, with approximately 6-8 distinct spots visible primarily near the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique vermiculated pattern consisting of interconnected, undulating high-luminance lines is present in the immediate post-branchial area, distinguishing it from the discrete circular blobs found further posterior.
